checkedAlternates.risk: Hydrodynamic Thrust Bearing supports axial thrust like Thrust Ball Bearing.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A hydrodynamic bearing rides on a pressurized fluid film without rolling elements (group-2), unlike a thrust ball bearing (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Needle bearings have thin rolling elements.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Needle rollers are elongated cylinders (group-3), not spherical balls (group-4).
